messages:
Sara (PM): Heads-up — AcmeCorp raised a security questionnaire that includes SOC2 + 7yr retention + ability to export raw audit logs on demand. Jamal looped me in. Need triage and decision on prioritization.
Jamal (Sales): Yep — they're asking for sign-off by EoQ. Very likely to commit to Dedicated if we can meet retention + export. High ARR motion :moneybag:
Mika (SE): Quick Q — do they require on-prem, or is VPC w/ customer-managed KMS sufficient?
Jamal (Sales): VPC + customer-managed KMS preferred. On-prem is a later conversation if we hit blockers.
Nina (Legal): Are they asking for a full SOC2 attestation from us, or just artifacts/evidence for their auditors?
Jamal (Sales): They want us to provide evidence (logs, config exports) and a SOC2 report during procurement. Also explicit: data access logs retained 7 years per their policy.
Sara (PM): Ok. Proposed triage plan: 1) Intake -> collect completed questionnaire + contract asks 2) Gap analysis (security + infra) 3) Define MLP (minimum launch package) 4) Prioritize into roadmap/backlog. Need ops for retention feasibility and cost.
Eli (Support): FYI current hosted default audit-log retention is 90 days. We can increase retention, but it needs cold-store + retention policies; cost + SLO impact.
Mika (SE): Engineering notes: export endpoints exist for ad-hoc audits, but long-term retention requires durable cold store + index for search. Rough estimate: 3-4 sprints to productize an export + retention pipeline with access controls.
Nina (Legal): For evidence, we can hand over logs + summaries. If customer-managed KMS is used we need to document responsibilities and key-rotation clauses. Also confirm whether they require us to run the SOC2 audit or only provide artifacts.
Sara (PM): Can everyone complete the intake form? forms-bot link: https://docs.redwood.ai/qna-intake — AcmeCorp entry created. I'll consolidate answers and outline launch criteria.
forms-bot: New intake created for AcmeCorp (ID: Q-2024-274). Reminder: attach questionnaire PDF and any procurement deadlines.
Jamal (Sales): Uploading the filled questionnaire PDF now.
Sara (PM): Triage decision: move to "compliance-enterprise" bucket, provisional priority = P1 for negotiation with AE. Action items: (a) Mika + Ops -> feasibility + rough infra diagram by Tue 2024-05-07 (b) Nina -> legal blockers & contract language by Wed 2024-05-08 (c) Eli -> support/cost delta estimate. I'll create backlog ticket and tag @eng-security.
Mika (SE): Acknowledged. I'll include storage cost scenarios (1yr vs 7yr) and a recommended MLP scope.
Eli (Support): Adding a note: similar retention request from HealthSys previously required an export pipeline + monthly snapshot; link saved in shared drive.
Sara (PM): If we can agree on VPC + customer KMS + export API + 1yr retention as MLP, we can move deal forward quickly and schedule Dedicated for Q3. If they insist on 7yr retention, escalate to product council for long-term storage plan.
Jamal (Sales): Got it — pushing the MLP offer first to keep procurement moving. :thumbsup:
Nina (Legal): I'll draft the legal notes for KMS responsibility and data retention warranty limits. If they require vendor SOC2 report, we'll coordinate with ops to surface current controls.
Sara (PM): Closing the loop: created ticket #PR-4123 and assigned. Will post backlog link once created. Thanks all — I'll update this thread with feasibility note and Nina's legal summary.
